verdict_reason: Both prior Criticals (400 schema type mismatch, contract divergence from api-contract.locked.yaml) are genuinely fixed, but the fix commits introduced a new Major RFC 9110 Location-header defect and a Minor countryCode validation regression.

todos.issue: Fix commits weakened countryCode from minLength:1 to maxLength:2/minLength:0, newly making it disagree with AddressRequest's @NotBlank (which rejects an empty string with a 400) - the opposite of the direction item 27 asked for on the sibling fields
todos.fix: Restore minLength: 1 on countryCode (keep the new maxLength: 2), matching @NotBlank + @Size(max=2), then regenerate with -Dopenapi.generate=true

todos.issue: New Location header block (POST 201) documents the header as a 'Relative URI', but a relative URI in Location on 201 Created is non-conformant with RFC 9110; the doc now faithfully exposes a real defect in OperatorController.create, which builds the header via URI.create(...) instead of an absolute URI
todos.fix: Fix OperatorController.create to build an absolute Location URI via ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest(), then update the header description here to 'Absolute URI of the created address' and regenerate with -Dopenapi.generate=true
